author: C. M. Ralston
title: Dwight Rutledge of Eastern Illinois University receives NAAC Emerging Leader Award
text:
Dwight Rutledge of Eastern Illinois University receives NAAC Emerging Leader Award
The National Association for Athletics Compliance announced on May 13 its 2026 award winners, who will be recognized at the NAAC Convention in Las Vegas from June 7 to June 10. Among the honorees is Dwight Rutledge, assistant athletic director for compliance at Eastern Illinois University, who has been named a recipient of the Emerging Leader Award.
The recognition highlights professionals with six to ten years of experience who are considered emerging leaders in athletics compliance. The announcement matters as it underscores the ongoing development and acknowledgment of talent within collegiate athletics administration.
"We are proud to recognize the exceptional group of 2026 NAAC Award winners! Their dedication, leadership, and impact continue to elevate our profession, and we look forward to celebrating their accomplishments at the 2026 NAAC Convention," said Hannah Delph, Membership and Awards Committee Chair and Assistant Athletic Director for Compliance at USF. "The NAAC Board and Awards Committee also sincerely thank our members for submitting such outstanding and well-deserved nominations."
Rutledge returned to Eastern Illinois University in September 2024 after previously serving as a graduate assistant in its compliance office during the 2015-16 academic year. His prior roles include associate athletic director for compliance at Knox College as well as positions at UIC, Western Illinois University, Upper Iowa University, Morehead State University, and University of West Florida. He holds a bachelor's degree from Northern Illinois University (2014) and a master's degree from EIU (2016). According to his colleagues, Rutledge is respected for his strong knowledge of NCAA legislation and his calm approach while supporting both staff members and student-athletes.
He is also recognized as a mentor who helps others develop confidence through clear guidance. The other award recipients include Ellen Ferris (Frank Kara Leadership Award), Deslyn Haywood (Rising Star Award), Maggie Peters (Rising Star Award), Alexis Anderson (Emerging Leader Award), Alycia Grieco (Division II Excellence Award), and the University of St. Thomas (Small Office Award).
NAAC serves as an association for compliance administrators in athletics education. It is administered by the National Association of Collegiate Directors of Athletics.
